description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with comprehensive infection prevention and control, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and staff. You will play a key role in educating our team and implementing critical health protocols.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and delivering educational programs for staff, as well as overseeing all aspects of infection control within the facility. This includes surveillance, policy implementation, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory guidelines. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour for this essential full-time role.

If you are an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for staff education and maintaining a safe, healthy environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and making a significant impact on the well-being of our community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience in staff development or education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care
Strong communication and organizational skills

description: We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This facility, with a capacity of 120 beds and a current census of 75, offers a unique opportunity for a professional eager to make a significant impact. We are committed to attracting top talent and offer competitive compensation for the right individual.The ideal candidate will be instrumental in enhancing the facility's presence and driving census growth. This role requires a proactive and strategic leader who can develop and execute effective marketing initiatives. You will be a key player in our team, contributing to the overall success and reputation of the center, with occasional weekend work required to meet business needs.
requirements: Professional demeanor and strong presentation skills
Proven track record of driving results and a proactive, results-oriented approach
Experience in healthcare marketing, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of market trends and effective marketing strategies
Availability to work occasional weekends as needed

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential therapy services on a flexible, as-needed basis, making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role and your expertise. We are also pleased to offer a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome you to our team. If you are a compassionate and skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity with attractive compensation, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP)
Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity offers flexibility for a professional committed to providing exceptional patient care and contributing to a supportive therapy team.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting patients in regaining mobility, strength, and function. Your responsibilities will include implementing treatment plans, documenting patient progress, and educating patients and families on therapeutic exercises. You will play a vital role in helping patients achieve their rehabilitation goals in a dynamic and caring environment.

Join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
CPR certification
Ability to work flexible PRN shifts
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Full-time COTA/PTA roles offer $28.00 - $37.00/hr. PRN rates will be discussed during the interview process.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Travel Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT. This is an exceptional opportunity for an RN looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time options available, offering a highly competitive annual salary.

In this vital role, you will provide high-quality nursing care to patients in the comfort of their own homes, contributing significantly to their well-being and recovery. Enjoy the autonomy of home health while exploring the beautiful Billings area and making a direct impact on patient lives.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana or a compact state.
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent experience in home health, acute care, or a similar setting.
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
Excellent clinical assessment and documentation skills.
Ability to travel to patient homes within the Billings area.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, with compensation based on experience and chosen contract type (full-time or part-time).

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Physician to join a thriving community health center in Greenville, SC. This role offers significant flexibility with part-time, PRN, or contract options, though full-time candidates are also highly encouraged to apply. You will be part of a team committed to providing comprehensive care, with a focus on internal medicine, family medicine, or med/ped specialties.

This position comes with a highly competitive compensation package, including a base salary of $210,000 and a robust bonus structure that can add up to an additional $50,000 annually. Enjoy excellent benefits, generous paid time off, and the potential for a $9,000 sign-on bonus on your first payday. We are open to candidates requiring travel or relocation assistance, and our compensation structure has recently been revamped to be highly attractive.
salaryShort: $210,000+ per year + up to $50,000 in bonuses
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Med/Ped
Ability to work part-time, PRN, or contract hours; full-time candidates also considered
Openness to travel or relocation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Base salary of $210,000 per year, with a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A $9,000 sign-on bonus is available on payday 1 with a signed promissory note. Total compensation can reach up to $260,000 annually.
